title: The Heroes; Or, Greek Fairy Tales for My Children
sourceTitle: The Heroes; Or, Greek Fairy Tales for My Children
author: Charles Kingsley
description: "The Heroes; Or, Greek Fairy Tales for My Children" by Charles Kingsley is a collection of retold Greek myths written during the late 19th century.
longDescription: The book serves as an engaging introduction to various legendary figures from Greek mythology, primarily aimed at children.

authorInfo.bio: Charles Kingsley (1819–1875) wrote The Heroes; Or, Greek Fairy Tales for My Children. Their work forms part of the historical literary record preserved in this edition. The linked reference offers further details about their life and bibliography.
